title: Linking ideas: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: I like cats, ___ I don't like dogs.
We took a taxi ___ it was raining.
The shop was closed, ___ we went home.

items.sentence: Because I was tired, so I went to bed.
items.wrong: Because I was tired, so I went
answers: I was tired, so I went
I was tired so I went
Because I was tired, I went
Because I was tired I went
items.explanationEs: No se usan because y so en la misma frase: quita uno de los dos. I was tired, so I went to bed, o Because I was tired, I went to bed.

items.sentence: She plays very well the piano.
items.explanationEs: El verbo y su objeto van juntos; el adverbio, después.

items.sentence: Do you prefer the beach and the mountains?
